Re.: 
Q1 FY27 post results earning call details 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Please note that the financial results of Zydus Lifesciences Limited for Q1 2026-27 (April-June 2026) 
will be declared on Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Post results Q&A session through webinar has been 
scheduled  on the same day, i.e. Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. IST (Indian Standard Time). 
Dr. Sharvil Patel, Managing Director, Zydus Lifesciences Limited, would be hosting the call. 
 
The details to join the call are provided in the attached file. 
 
To join the call: 
   
Please pre-register by CLICKING HERE or type paste the link below on you browser: 
https://bit.ly/4w2juWX 
 
Pursuant to regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015, the audio recording of the earnings call will be available 
on the Company’s website at https://www.zyduslife.com/investorzone. The transcript of the call will 
also be available subsequently at https://www.zyduslife.com/investorzone. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For, Zydus Lifesciences Limited 
 
 
 
Dhaval N. Soni 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
